sn17.3:1.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave aññatarasmiṃ udakarahade mahākumma kulaṃ ciranivāsi ahosi.
sn17.3:1.4: atha kho bhikkhave aññataro kummo yena aññataro kummo tenupasaṅkami aññataraṃ kummaṃ etadavoca
sn17.3:1.5: mā kho tvaṃ tāta kumma etaṃ padesaṃ agamāsīti.
sn17.3:1.6: agamāsi kho bhikkhave so kummo taṃ padesaṃ
sn17.3:1.8: atha kho bhikkhave so kummo yena so kummo tenupasaṅkami.
sn17.3:1.9: addasā kho bhikkhave so kummo taṃ kummaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
sn17.3:1.11: kacci tvaṃ tāta kumma na taṃ padesaṃ agamāsīti.
sn17.3:1.12: agamāsiṃ khvāhaṃ tāta kumma taṃ padesanti.
sn17.3:1.13: kacci panāpi tāta kumma akkhato anupahatoti.
sn17.3:1.14: akkhato khomhi tāta kumma anupahato atthi pana me idaṃ suttakaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhanti.
sn17.3:1.15: taggha hi tāta kumma akkhato taggha upahato
sn17.3:1.16: etena hi te tāta kumma suttakena pitaro ca pitāmahā ca anayaṃ āpannā byasanaṃ āpannā
sn17.3:1.17: gacchadāni tvaṃ tāta kumma nadāni tvaṃ amhākanti.
sn17.3:2.1: luddhoti kho bhikkhave mārassetaṃ pāpimato adhivacanaṃ.
sn17.3:2.4: yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ assādeti nikāmeti
sn17.3:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu papatāya anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathā kāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.
sn17.3:2.6: evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkāra siloko …pe…
